steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding duration.

args.goal: set the single-stage auction Evaluation time to 30 minutes and save the schedule; stop when the schedule shows the saved evaluation duration

steps.note: The catalog's schedule step cannot specify evaluation duration, so complete that missing on-screen schedule detail.

args.goal: add exactly one Required T&C clause to the event and stop when the clause is visible in the Terms and Conditions section

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause before publication.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify publication reached a real event page.
Submit Vendor A's quote of 100 through the vendor portal, including the vendor-side submission flow.
Verify Vendor A's bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower quote of 90 through the second vendor portal session.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before comparing and awarding bids.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify ranks follow the lowest bid and that both vendor bids are ranked.
Verify Vendor B, the second bidder with price 90, is Rank 1.
Award the entire available quantity to the lowest vendor.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted award with a remark

steps.note: A separate approver login is required and cannot be performed by the available catalog session.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order.
Verify one PO contains the awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Navigate to the events list to verify the completed event is in history.
Open the History tab after completion.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
